definitions.explanation: The fleshy part of the face below the eyes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{頬|ほお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伝|つた}った→伝う：28247_tsutau⟧。
{頬|ほお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{赤|あか}らめた→赤らめる：28248_akarameru⟧。
⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頬|ほお}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ふっくら→ふっくら：28254_fukkura⟧⟦している→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{子|こ}ども→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{頬|ほお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{膨|ふく}らませて→膨らます：09646_fukuramasu⟧⟦{怒|おこ}っている→怒る：00876_okoru⟧。
examples.english: The child is puffing out their cheeks in anger.
examples.notes: {頬|ほお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{膨|ふく}らませる→膨らます：09646_fukuramasu⟧ = to puff out one's cheeks (sulking/pouting)

examples.japanese: ⟦{冷|つめ}たい→冷たい：00681_tsumetai⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{頬|ほお}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当|あ}たって→当たる：01860_ataru⟧、⟦{思|おも}わず→思わず：02549_omowazu⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{閉|と}じた→閉じる：02303_tojiru⟧。
examples.english: The cold wind hit my cheeks and I instinctively closed my eyes.

notes:
PRONUNCIATION:
{頬|ほお} and ⟦{頬|ほほ}→頬：00110_hoho⟧ are both standard; ほお is more common today and is the reading in compounds ({頬骨|ほおぼね}, {頬紅|ほおべに}, ⟦{頬杖|ほおづえ}→頬杖：10678_hoozue⟧). Small children and casual speakers say ほっぺ or ⟦ほっぺた→ほっぺた：21486_hoppeta⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {頬|ほお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{染|そ}める→染める：04253_someru⟧: to blush (literary)
- {頬|ほお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{赤|あか}らめる→赤らめる：28248_akarameru⟧: to flush, turn red in the face
- {頬|ほお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{膨|ふく}らませる→膨らむ：05342_fukuramu⟧: to puff out one's cheeks (sulking)
- ⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{頬|ほお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伝|つた}う→伝う：28247_tsutau⟧: tears run down one's cheeks

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {頬|ほお}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧: (food) so delicious one's cheeks might fall off
- {頬|ほお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つねる: to pinch one's cheek (to check one is not dreaming)

COMPOUNDS:
- {頬骨|ほおぼね}: cheekbone
- {頬紅|ほおべに}: blusher, rouge
